title: K2 Space showcase
description: A two-line title on black with deep air above it, then one full-bleed render (2:1 on desktop, tall portrait on phones) with small corner-bracket hotspot markers placed over it, each with a centre dot and a label that appears on hover. The title reveals line by line, the render settles from 115% and blurred to sharp, and the markers fade in once it is in view.
notes: markers are placed in percent of the frame, so they stay on their subject at every width
CSS only: without scroll-timeline support or under reduced motion everything simply shows
name: k2space-showcase
